keyMethods: Number steps and organize related steps into sections.
Establish a shared coordinate system, orientation, and reference direction.
Identify the exact piece, connection point, orientation, and relative position.
Use consistent names for pieces and parts.
Estimate distance consistently using agreed reference units.
Make reversible changes before irreversible ones.
Review unclear instructions and practice with a partner.
